URL: https://www.independent.co.uk/bulletin/news/burnham-cabinet-reshuffle-rachel-reeves-lammy-b3018291.html
NOTE: Independent (20 Jul 2026) — Reeves sacked as Chancellor; "I'm proud" reaction; Lammy, Reed, Kyle out. 11 Starmer cabinet figures gone.
Rachel Reeves (on X): "I wish the very best of luck to my successor, Andy and his cabinet. You have my full support, and I will continue to play my part in helping this Labour government deliver the change the country needs." Reeves — first ever female Chancellor — is understood to have turned down "a big job" offered by Burnham. David Lammy (former Deputy PM/Justice Secretary): "A new prime minister is entitled to build his own team, and I wish Andy Burnham and the new cabinet every success." Darren Jones: "Andy Burnham has called to tell me I won't be a part of his new cabinet."
